scope: v0.26.5 RC4 attempt 35 replaces the failed automatic Recomps-folder discovery UX with an explicit persistent multi-game Recomps library while preserving all validated RC3 rendering, naming, controller, browser, streaming, GameCube, downloads, provider and installer behavior. Recomps remains a first-class native provider and never becomes an emulator platform. The provider management page must expose Add Recomp Game / Add Another Recomp Game and allow the user to select exactly one native .exe at a time through the controller-friendly native file picker. Each selected executable appends a separate persistent RecompGames record without replacing existing entries; duplicate exact executable paths are rejected; the stored exact LaunchTarget is authoritative and launches directly through Start-ExternalProcess without Legendary/gogdl/Nile or emulator routing. The Recomps picker must display .exe files only, not .lnk or .url. No configured Recomps root, recursive folder scan, executable scoring/guessing, updater/helper filtering heuristic, or Refresh/Re-scan workflow is authoritative or required. Each manually added game must appear in the Recomps provider and merged Games library, survive restart and unrelated Save-Config calls, keep normal Huymaier artwork/details/favorites/recent integration, and remain visible as EXE NOT FOUND if the saved executable is moved or missing so it can be removed. Each game page must expose Launch when present, Open game folder, Remove from Recomps and Back; it must not expose provider install/update/verify/move/uninstall actions. Remove from Recomps requires native confirmation, removes only that single library record plus stale recent/favorite references, and must never delete or modify the selected executable or game files. Retired Recomps root-folder Settings/actions must be absent from normal UI; any stale legacy action state must safely redirect to the one-EXE picker rather than revive scanning. Preserve V7 native Direct3D 11 GPU shelf ownership and load the final manual Recomps resolver after V7 so old Get-HcRecompGames/root-setting wrappers cannot override the manual list. Preserve HC3D v2 mirrored winding, material face culling/double-sided handling, authored UV/sampler fixes, full-screen model viewer UV orientation, shared 3D brightness, canonical PS4/Sega CD/NES/SNES identities, Xbox PC versus Original Xbox isolation, all 36 GLB mappings, persistent 3D Model Cache, frozen emulator console selection behavior and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Parse all shipped PowerShell with Windows PowerShell 5.1 and reject protected automatic-variable collisions. Exact-source validation must prove multi-game append, duplicate guard, restart persistence, EXE-only picker, remove-without-delete, provider catalog ownership, no folder scan, final manual ownership after V7, bootstrap/installer inclusion and source-list inclusion. Release-shaped validation must additionally prove the packaged core natively persists RecompGames in defaults/load/array normalization, final manual owner loads after V7, both manual runtimes ship and preflight/cache correctly, and staged Recomps behavior cannot fall back to folder scanning. Then run the full existing x64 FSE host build, installer rollback/tamper/failure injection, stabilization, unified cursor, streaming, GameCube, V7 GPU shelf, active-download stability, Steam owned-library and final SHA verification gates. Upload only if every gate succeeds and the request parent exactly equals production_source 51268dbd4f2ffaa3b35c6e2dba1f456504635acf.
